paragraphs: Ravin the elder before Rav Pappa, Bava Batra 146b. Ravin the elder explained it before Rav, Kiddushin 53, beginning of b. Rav Huna bar Rav Yehoshua, Rav Pappa’s colleague (see there), explained his words; they were among the later ones after Rav Huna. Thus it cannot be this Ravin the elder; one must say there are two. In chapter Keitzad Tzolin 74b he made food for Rav. Thus there are two, or Rav Pappa should be Rav Pappa the elder.
